hero.credit: Item is held by John Oxley Library, State Library of Queensland
hero.description: Andrew Scott was born in Newcastletown, Scotland about 1815, and Married in East Maitland, New South Wales in 1860. He died at his property, Hornet Bank Station 5 June 1892. (Description supplied with photograph.).
